subject: english
stem: A guide points toward several islands on the horizon. What should the guide say?
options: Those islands are part of the park.
That islands is part of the park.

optionRationales.reason: This islands were here now.：多項數、時態與距離衝突。
Those islands are part of the park.：遠處複數 islands 使用 those 並搭 are。
That islands is part of the park.：指示詞與名詞數不合。
These island are far there.：近指示詞、單數名詞與 are 不合。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「以單複數與說話者所建立的近／遠視角選 this、that、these、those，並讓後接名詞與 be 一致。」可推出 Those islands are part of the park.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Those islands are part of the park. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
